lib/organizations/organizationRequiredSe: This is the SERVER half of the refusal (the 2026-09-19 ruling's organization_required envelope). It runs in a Next route handler, where the three client states do not exist: there is no Redux store, no bootstrap to still be resolving, and no picker to render. Its sentence is the wire `message`/`user_message` the CLIENT then reads through the three-state hooks (lib/organizations/fetchWithOrganization.ts holds, asks and replays). Reading useOrganizationRequired here is impossible, not merely unidiomatic.
features/scopes/components/active-contex: The 'Pick an organization' lines are column hints inside the picker's OWN Organization column: they read the picker engine's checked/focused orgs (engine.isOn('org', …), focusOrgId, u.orgs), never appContext.organization_id, so there is no boot race to lose — the hint is true the instant it renders, and the fix is the column beside it. Checked GATES-TAIL-2, 2026-09-25.
features/agents/components/context-previ: 'Choose an organization and the preview shows…' is the first step of the inspector's own drill-down: selection.org comes from the page address the person drives (controlled; the page owns the selection), never from appContext.organization_id, so it cannot be spelled during boot. It is an instruction for the Organization column above it, not a refusal. Checked GATES-TAIL-2, 2026-09-25.
